content: Elisee u bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, i Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɑri swɑɑ dɑkio i nɔ. U nɛɛ, siɑ ɑmɑdɑɑre som kɑ ɑlikɑmɑ yɑ ko n wɑ̃ɑ Sɑmɑrin ɡbɑ̃rɑ kɔnnɔwɔ bɑ n dɔrɑmɔ. Bɑ koo som mɛn kilo wɔkurɑ yiru dwe kɑ sii ɡeesun ɡobi tiɑ kpɑ bu ɔɔsun kilo yɛndɑ nnɛ dwe kɑ sii ɡeesun ɡobi tiɑ.
Sinɑ bokon kɔ̃sobun wiruɡii u Elisee wisɑ u nɛɛ, bɑɑ Yinni Gusunɔ ù n fɛnɛntibɑ yɑburɑ wɔllɔ yɑ koo koorɑ mɛ? Elisee u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, kɑɑ ye wɑ kɑ wunɛn nɔni. Adɑmɑ ɑ ǹ ye dimɔ.
Siriɡibɑ duki suɑ
bɑ ben sɑnsɑni deri
N deemɑ tɔmbu nnɛ ɡɑbu be bɑ bɑrɑ disiɡiru mɔ bɑ rɑ n wɑ̃ɑ wuu ɡen kɔnnɔwɔ bɑ sɔ̃ɔnɑ bɑ nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ sɑ ko n wɑ̃ɑ mini sere su kɑ ɡbi.
Sɑ̀ n mɑɑ sɔ̃ mini, ɡɔɔ turo wiyɑ mi. Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, su dɑ su tii Siriɡibu nɔmu bɛriɑ. Bɑ̀ n sun deri sɑ n wɑ̃ɑ, bɑ̀ n mɑɑ sun ɡo su ɡbi.
Yerɑ bɑ seewɑ yoki yɑm bere berebu bɑ dɑ mi Siriɡibu bɑ ben sɑnsɑni ɡire. Ye bɑ turɑ mi, bɑ deemɑ ɡoo sɑri.

N deemɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u derɑ Siriɡibu bɑ tɑbu kɛkɛ yi dumi ɡɑwen wurenu nuɑ, kɑ mɑɑ mɑɑsɔbu, kɑ tɑbu kowobu dɑbi dɑbinu. Yerɑ bɑ nɛɛ, Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko u Hɛtibɑ kɑ Eɡibitiɡibu ɡobi kɑ̃ bu kɑ nɑ bu sun tɑbu wɔri.

Yerɑ bɑ seewɑ yoki yɑm bere berebu ɡe, bɑ duki suɑ bɑ ben kuu bekunuɡinu deri kɑ ben dumi kɑ kɛtɛkunu kɑ ben sɑnsɑni nɡe mɛ bɑ kɑ ye ɡirɑ. Bɑ duki yɑkikirɑwɑ nɔm dirɑ, bu ɡesi wɑ bu ben hunde fɑɑbɑ ko.

Sɑɑ ye tɔn be, bɑ turɑ sɑnsɑni yen mi, yerɑ bɑ duɑ kuu bekuruɡiru ɡɑru sɔɔ. Miyɑ bɑ dĩɑnu wɑ bɑ di bɑ nɔrɑ. Mɑ bɑ sii ɡeesu ɡurɑ kɑ wurɑbɑ kɑ yɑ̃nu, bɑ dɑ bɑ ye kpuro beruɑ. Yen biru bɑ wurɑmɑ bɑ duɑ ɡɑrun mi, mɑ bɑ ɡɑ̃ɑ dɑbinu wɑ bɑ ɡurɑ bɑ beruɑ.
Gɔ̃ɔrɑ kpɑ Sɑmɑriɔ
Yen biru bɑ ɡerunɑ bɑ nɛɛ, n ǹ ɡeɑ sɑ mɔ̀ mini. Domi ɡisɔn tɔ̃ɔ te, lɑbɑɑri ɡeɑn tɔ̃rɑ. Sɑ̀ n mɑɑri sere yɑm mu kɑ sɑ̃rɑ, sɑ ko nɔni swɑ̃ɑru wɑ. Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, su dɑ wuuɔ tɛ̃ su sinɑ boko nɔɔsiɑ.

Ye bɑ turɑ wuun duu yerɔ, bɑ wuun kɔ̃so turo sokɑ, bɑ nùn sɑɑriɑ ye bɑ wɑ. Bɑ nɛɛ, sɑ duɑ Siriɡibun sɑnsɑniɔ. Mɛyɑ sɑ ǹ mɑɑ ɡoon nɔɔ nuɑ ɡɑm. Dumi kɑ kɛtɛkunu tɔnɑwɑ sɑ wɑ mi, ni bɑ sɔri, kɑ sere mɑɑ ben kuu bekunuɡinu nu yɔ̃ nɡe mɛ bɑ kɑ nu ɡirɑ.
Mɑ wuun kɔ̃sobu bɑ mɛnnɑ bɑ dɑ sinɑ bokon mi, bɑ nùn ɡɑri yi sɑɑriɑ.

Yerɑ sinɑ boko u seewɑ wɔ̃kuru u win bwɑ̃ɑbu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, kon bɛɛ sɔ̃ bwisi yi Siriɡibu bɑ sun kuɑ. Bɑ yɛ̃ mɑ sɑ wɑ̃ɑ ɡɔ̃ɔru sɔɔ, yen sɔ̃nɑ bɑ ben sɑnsɑni deri bɑ dɑ bɑ kukuɑ yɑkɑsɔ, mɑ bɑ nɛɛ, bɛsɛ Isirelibɑ sɑ̀ n yɑrɑ bɛsɛn wuun di, kpɑ bu sun mwɛɛri wɑsiru. Yen biru bu du bɛsɛn wuuɔ.
Yerɑ win bɔ̃ɔ turo u nɛɛ, tɔn be bɑ ɡu kɔ wuu ɡeni sɔɔ kɑ be bɑ tie, tiɑ yerɑ. Yen sɔ̃, ɑ de su dumi nɔɔbu wunɑ dumi yi yi tie sɔɔ, su kɑ ɡɑbu ɡɔri kpɑ su wɑ ye n koo bu deemɑ.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ bɑ tɑbu kɛkɛ ye dumi ɡɑwe wunɑ yiru kɑ sere mɑɑsɔ dumiɡibu. Mɑ sinɑ boko u nɛɛ, bu Siriɡii be nɑɑ swĩiyɔ bu wɑ.
Yerɑ bɑ bu nɑɑ swĩi sere dɑɑ te bɑ mɔ̀ Yuudɛniɔ. Mɑ bɑ Siriɡii ben yirɑ ye sɔɔ yɑ̃nu wɑ ni bɑ kɔ̃ kɔ̃ sɛndɑrun sɔ̃. Yen biru sɔmɔ be, bɑ ɡɔsirɑmɑ bɑ nɑ bɑ sinɑ boko ye kpuro sɔ̃ɔwɑ.

Yerɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ yɑrɑ bɑ dɑ bɑ Siriɡibun sɑnsɑni wɔri bɑ yen yɑ̃nu ɡurɑ. Mɑ som kɑ ɔɔsu yɑ koorɑ. Mɑ bɑ som mɛn kilo wɔkurɑ yiru dɔrɑmɔ kɑ sii ɡeesun ɡobi tiɑ. Mɑ bɑ mɑɑ ɔɔsu kilo yɛndɑ nnɛ dɔrɑmɔ kɑ sii ɡeesun ɡobi tiɑ nɡe mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u rɑɑ ɡeruɑ.
Sinɑ boko u win kɔ̃sobun wiruɡii wi yi ɡbɑ̃rɑ kɔnnɔwɔ. Adɑmɑ tɔmbɑ nùn tɑɑkɑ bɑ ɡo, nɡe mɛ Elisee u rɑɑ ɡeruɑ sɑɑ ye sinɑ boko u dɑ win mi.
U nɛɛ, som kɑ ɔɔsu yɑ ko n wɑ̃ɑ Sɑmɑrin ɡbɑ̃rɑ kɔnnɔwɔ. Kpɑ bu som mɛn kilo wɔkurɑ yiru dwe kɑ sii ɡeesun ɡobi tiɑ. Kpɑ bu ɔɔsun kilo yɛndɑ nnɛ dwe kɑ sii ɡeesun ɡobi tiɑ.
Adɑmɑ sinɑ bokon kɔ̃sobun wiruɡii wi, u nɛɛ, bɑɑ Yinni Gusunɔ ù n fɛnɛntibɑ yɑburɑ wɔllɔ, yeni yɑ koo koorɑ mɛ? Mɑ Elisee u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, kɑɑ ye wɑ kɑ wunɛn nɔni. Adɑmɑ ɑ ǹ ye dimɔ.
Mɛyɑ n mɑɑ nùn kuɑ. Domi tɔmbɑ nùn tɑɑkɑ bɑ ɡo.
Kurɔ Sunɛmuɡii wi,
u wurɑmɑ win temɔ
